content.text: See Full Arkansas Constitution Article 6. Executive Department Section 5. Qualifications of Governor Current 1874 1874 Constitution Qualifications of Governor No person shall be eligible to the office of Governor except a citizen of the United States, who shall have attained the age of thirty years, and shall have been seven years a resident of this State.
